newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Airlines extends winter sale.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Airlines extends winter sale.

text.p: Southwest Airlines Co said it has extended its 'Winter Freedom Sale' and fares may now be purchased through December 19, for travel from January 6 through March 6.
The original offer, announced last week, applied to tickets purchased by December 12.

Tickets must be purchased within one day of making reservations and are nonrefundable, but may be applied toward purchase of future travel on Southwest Airlines if unused. Fares start at $29 each way, based on roundtrip travel.
